# FreeModel

Use `freemodel/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "freemodel-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "freemodel/claude-fable-5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `FREEMODEL_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/anthropic`

## Default base URL

`https://cc.freemodel.dev/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `FREEMODEL_BASE_URL`.
